clips.send: Modern encryption. Today computers scramble data with secret keys that are long numbers — often 128 or 256 bits. 2 to the power of 128 possible keys is so many that trying them all would take longer than the age of the universe. The padlock and “https://” mean your connection to a website is encrypted.

clips.send: Frequency analysis. In English, E (about 13 percent), T and A are the most common letters. Count the letters in a cipher text: its most common letter probably stands for E. The Arab scholar al-Kindi described this method in the 800s.

clips.send: Caesar cipher. Shift every letter the same number of places: with key 3, A, D, B, E… X, A. Julius Caesar reportedly used a shift of 3 for military messages. There are only 25 useful keys — a patient person can just try them all.

clips.send: Dont mix up: Encryption hides what you send, but the padlock does not prove a website is honest — scam sites can have one too.

clips.send: Bits and bytes. A bit is one 0 or 1 — like a light switch, off or on. 8 bits equals 1 byte: 2⁸ equals 256 different patterns, enough for 0–255. 1 KB about a thousand bytes, 1 MB about a million, 1 GB about a billion.

clips.send: Dont mix up: A longer, random key is stronger than a short word like “CAT”.

clips.send: Pixels and RGB. A screen picture is a grid of tiny dots called pixels. Each pixel mixes red, green and blue light, each from 0 to 255 — about 16.7 million colours. (255, 255, 255) is white, (0, 0, 0) is black, (255, 255, 0) is yellow.

clips.send: Vigenère cipher. A key word gives a different shift for each letter: C equals 2, O equals 14, D equals 3, E equals 4…. The same letter can turn into different letters, which hides the letter pattern. It was called “the indecipherable cipher” for about 300 years — until people found ways to break it in the 1800s.

clips.send: Dont mix up: A code swaps whole words (like “eagle” equals “meet at noon”); a cipher changes letters by a rule and a key.

clips.send: 维吉尼亚密码。用一个密钥单词给每个字母不同的移位：C 等于 2，O 等于 14，D 等于 3，E 等于 4……。同一个字母会变成不同的字母，字母的规律就被藏起来了。它曾被称为“无法破译的密码”约300年，直到19世纪才有人找到破解方法。

clips.send: 凯撒密码。把每个字母都往后挪同样的位数：密钥为3时，A，D，B，E……X，A。据记载，尤利乌斯·凯撒用移位3来传递军事消息。有用的密钥只有25个——有耐心的人可以挨个试一遍。

clips.send: 现代加密。今天，计算机用很长的数字作为密钥来打乱数据——通常是128位或256位。2的128次方种可能的密钥实在太多，全部试一遍所需的时间比宇宙的年龄还长。浏览器上的小锁和“https://”表示你和网站之间的连接是加密的。

clips.send: 像素与RGB。屏幕上的图片由许多叫作像素的小点组成。每个像素混合红、绿、蓝三种光，每种取0—255——约1670万种颜色。（255，255，255）是白色，（0，0，0）是黑色，（255，255，0）是黄色。
